jcr:title: OSGi Services in Sling Applications
author: cms-admin
body:
OSGi services form the backbone of Apache Sling applications. Services are interfaces that define contracts, with implementations registered in the OSGi service registry. This dynamic service model allows for loose coupling and runtime reconfiguration.

In Sling, services are typically annotated with @Component and registered using Declarative Services (DS). The @Reference annotation enables dependency injection, allowing components to dynamically bind to services as they become available.

Common service patterns in Sling include ResourceResolverFactory for content access, SlingScriptResolver for script resolution, and custom business logic services. Services can be configured through the OSGi Configuration Admin service.
summary: How OSGi services enable modular and dynamic functionality in Sling applications.
tags: OSGi Services, Declarative Services, Service Registry, Dependency Injection, Configuration Admin
title: OSGi Services in Sling Applications
